summary: Browser verification confirms that both workspace member icons use black in system-dark mode. The candidate fix uses the themed button foreground, including before the theme is resolved.
currentBehavior: Confirmed on the dev source in an isolated browser fixture with real components and app CSS; the live dev workspace had no eligible member rows. PR #2753 (https://github.com/chester-hill-solutions/callcaster/pull/2753) is awaiting review and merge.
resolution: Use the compact icon-xs ghost buttons and inherit their themed foreground for both icons. Browser measurements confirm 12 px icons in 28 px buttons and 8 px role dots; preserve the next-themes provider and system default.

summary: A read-only dry-run Twilio prune report exists in master (scripts/twilio-resource-prune-report.mjs) driven by a shared policy module that classifies every resource as KEEP / STALE / UNKNOWN with an environment check and an owner check, and the only deletion path (scripts/local/prune-environment-twiml-apps.mjs) deletes nothing but closed pull-request preview TwiML Apps, dry-run by default.

existingTests: test/twilio-resource-prune-policy.test.ts — 31 policy cases (environment check, owner check, keep list, assertPrunable guard); no test exercises a real delete (there is no delete path for workspace-owned resources)
rootCause: PARTIAL, and manual. The report and both checks are in master, but the goal says "Find and remove stale Twilio resources in development, review, and closed-preview environments" and the removal half is only implemented for closed-preview TwiML Apps: the only `.remove()` call in the repo is in prune-environment-twiml-apps.mjs. There is no delete path for a stale messaging service, incoming phone number, or subaccount, and by design a workspace-owned resource can never be STALE (UNKNOWN), so dev/review-owned resources are never removed automatically — that matches the issue's own "do not remove production resources automatically" but leaves "remove in development and review environments" unbuilt. The report is a script against a live Twilio account with live credentials and a live database, so a human must run it and act on the STALE list to confirm the behaviour; the classification logic itself is machine-checked. Also note the candidate PR commit b4046027 is unrelated to this issue (it is a CI ledger-drift gate) — the real work is the 2026-10-19 release commit 91c4409b, which added the report, the policy module and the shared live-environment list.

recommendedTitle: Detect dev-only fixes correctly in the issue verification planner
summary: The planner treated Git ancestry stdout as a boolean, so a candidate present on dev but absent from master was classified as requiring implementation. The source fix uses confirmed exit results for both refs.
currentBehavior: At dev@e4bb8ac6, hasDevOnlyFix returns false for the current origin/dev candidate even though the master check exits 1 and the dev check exits 0. PARTIAL and NOT_FIXED code verdicts consequently plan In progress instead of on-dev.
rootCause: git merge-base --is-ancestor reports through its exit code and produces empty stdout. A normal non-ancestor result also throws from execFileSync and skips the second predicate in the shared try block.
resolution: Use a small Git ancestry helper that requires exit 1 against master and exit 0 against dev. Keep unknown refs and malformed candidates conservative. Exercise the actual dry-run CLI with temporary Git graphs and a GitHub boundary that rejects writes.
existingTests: Ten real-CLI cases pass. Original source fails three dev-only cases while seven controls pass.
Controls cover already-released, unrelated, missing and malformed candidates; unavailable refs; and the remaining-person on-qa route.
Negative controls: inverted master ancestry fails four cases; treating an unavailable master as a confirmed miss fails one. The restored source passes all ten.
acceptanceCriteria: PARTIAL and NOT_FIXED code verdicts with a confirmed dev-only candidate plan on-dev.
A candidate in master or outside dev, invalid data and unavailable refs retain the conservative path.
Remaining operator actions still plan on-qa.
The real dry-run CLI runs with a temporary Git graph and rejects GitHub writes during tests.
trackerRecommendation: Bug; assigned to wra-sol; Priority, Effort and environment unset. Project Status Backlog verified in the browser. No parent, children, blockers or linked fixing PR at the start. The internal tooling fix is ready for comprehensive checks.
